items.title: Checkout with Luggage
items.getThere: Taxi to Kowloon Station (Airport Express). Airport Express Taxi Interchange Offer (18 Sep 2026–17 Sep 2027): show an original same-day taxi receipt of HK$50+ at the Kowloon Station AEL Customer Service Centre for 50% off the Octopus fare (HK$52.5 adult to Airport).
tips: Ask the driver for a printed receipt — photos or screenshots are not accepted; one receipt covers up to 5 people.
If using In-town Check-in, redeem the taxi offer at the Customer Service Centre before entering the In-town Check-in area.
items.watch: Taxi offer is Octopus-only (not smart tickets, not combinable with other offers) and must be used immediately after redemption.

items.title: Kowloon Station Bag Drop
items.hours: Cathay Pacific In-town Check-in at Kowloon Station: 6:00 am–3:00 pm. Check in from 24 h up to 90 min before departure, within service hours.
items.cost: Free check-in, but entry to the In-town Check-in area deducts the full Airport Express fare: Kowloon–Airport HK$105 (Octopus/contactless/QR) or HK$115 (AEL QR Code Ticket).
highlights: Smart Check-in Kiosks print boarding passes and bag tags; then Self Bag Drop: belt, face scan, scan tag, collect claim tag.
No further charge at the platform gate later — the fare was taken at the In-town Check-in gate.
tips: Use the SAME Octopus/card for the In-town Check-in gate and the platform gate; MTR caps it at 9 Octopus transactions in between, so pay for Sham Shui Po snacks with a different card.
Cathay confirms a valid Airport Express ticket is needed to use any Hong Kong In-town Check-in.
items.watch: E-passport (electronic travel document) required; codeshares on other airlines excluded. Bags max 145×100×85 cm and 32 kg.

items.title: Sham Shui Po — Breakfast, Market Streets, Old Kowloon
highlights: Apliu Street street market: phone accessories, audio/electrical cables, batteries, film cameras, alarm clocks, second-hand radios and vintage typewriters; haggling expected. Infernal Affairs (2002) audio-shop scene was shot here.
Kung Wo Beancurd Factory, 118 Pei Ho St (since 1960, Michelin-listed 2020): stone-ground silky tofu pudding, beancurd puffs, deep-fried tofu, sugar-free soy milk.
Sun Heung Yuen (Kin Kee), G/F 38 Kweilin St (since 1968): beef-and-egg sandwich — marinated beef fried with egg; +HK$1 to toast.
tips: Protein breakfast: Sun Heung Yuen's beef-and-egg sandwich, then Kung Wo for soy milk and fried tofu.
Kung Wo grinds soybeans each morning on a granite stone mill — the retro green-and-white mosaic shop is worth a look.
items.watch: Sun Heung Yuen is popular with locals — expect a wait. Kung Wo's golden fish tofu (魚腐) is a signature. Opening hours for these spots were not confirmed on official pages.

items.title: Back Toward Kowloon Station
items.getThere: MTR Sham Shui Po → Kowloon: check the MTR Trip Planner or MTR Mobile app for the current interchange and time, or take a taxi.
tips: Each MTR ride on the In-town Check-in Octopus counts toward the 9-transaction limit before you re-enter the Airport Express platform.

items.title: Airport Express → HKG
items.hours: Kowloon → Airport first train 05:53, last 00:52 (timetable effective 13 Sep 2026); trains about every 10 min.
items.cost: Kowloon–Airport adult HK$105 Octopus/contactless/QR, HK$115 AEL QR Code Ticket (already paid at In-town Check-in). Ride Together group tickets: 2 for HK$150, 3 for HK$210, 4 for HK$250.
tips: Group tickets are same-day paper Single Journey Tickets bought at the Customer Service Centre; In-town Check-in entry lists only Octopus, contactless card, QR or AEL QR Code Ticket — confirm with staff before buying.
items.watch: Bags already checked at Kowloon: at HKG go straight to Departures with boarding passes.

items.title: Cathay Pacific CX840 Non-Stop Flight to JFK
items.hours: Scheduled 16:35 HKT → 19:05 EST same day; 15h30 block.
highlights: Usually an Airbus A350-900 (e.g., B-LRF, B-LRQ, B-LRT).
tips: Power banks: max two per passenger, carry-on only, no in-flight recharging (HKIA notice, 30 Mar 2026).
Before the gate, have boarding pass and passport ready; e-passport holders aged 7+ can use the e-Security Gates.
items.watch: HKIA notes extra US-required security measures on electronic devices for US-bound flights. Schedule data is third-party; the Cathay app and boarding pass are final.
